confirmed: Actual source is jxmh_out.do JSONP: m=bks_jxrl_all or yjs_jxrl_all with dates and jsoncallback=m, fetched in three-week segments.
Rows use nq, fl, nr, dd, kssj, jssj. Parser accepts 上课/实验, derives week from each date and first Monday, maps times to sections, and merges course name, room, weekday, begin, end.
Hardcoded 14 sections exist, first 08:00-08:45 and last 21:00-21:45; this supports only a broad 14-period concept.
Calendar API supplies jyzdyt and xnxq; summer is treated as 12 weeks, other semesters as 18.
contradictions: No zhkbcx, strHTML, gridColumns, gridData, mainHref, blue_red_none or HTML grid-coordinate extraction exists in pinned source. Sleepy matrix claims of naming/protocol equivalence are unsupported.
No week-expression parsing for 全周, 前八周, 后八周 or 单双周 exists; week membership comes from JSONP nq dates.
Sleepy matrix says periods 10/11/14 are 17:00-17:45, 18:45-19:30, 21:15-22:00; piggyham uses 17:05-17:50, 17:55-18:40, 21:00-21:45. Same 14-slot-table claim is false.
README mentions in-WebView fetch, while implemented LoginPage calls fetchJxrlSegmentsHttp; rely on code for protocol characterization.
